title: I Let GPT-6 Use My Computer For A Whole Day
description:
OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on 3 September 2026. The headline is computer use, meaning the model browses, clicks, fills forms and operates software the way a person does.

In OpenAI's own demos it completed a modelling task from the Excel World Championship about four times faster than the winning human competitor, read a W-2 and prepared a tax return draft for review, and laid out a circuit board in KiCad from a schematic.

It scores 72.6% on OSWorld 2.0, ahead of Claude Opus 5 at 70.2% and GPT-5.6 Sol at 65.7%, though all of these figures are self-reported by OpenAI. It still fails more than one task in four.

Worth knowing: it is not available on the free plan, and Agent mode has been retired, so the current path is the Work toggle in ChatGPT.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XeuE05TEVZTLiZuc8wg0jPfjrAUurOIWqvyarWu9J4k/edit?usp=sharing
